newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on Asian market, US harvest.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on Asian market, US harvest.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on weakness in the Asian market, especially in the benchmark Thai market, traders said.
Pressure also came from the U.S. rice harvest where aggressive combining and overall excellent yields have been reported, they said.

The early gains in rice futures were tied to short covering as the September contract expired. There was a lack of follow-through buying early in the session and the market quickly sagged, the traders said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 550 contracts, down from 602 Wednesday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 50 contracts, up from five Wednesday.
Rice futures closed seven to 10 cents per cwt lower, with November down 9-1/2 at $10.07 per cwt.
